caption: The drawing depicts a single armchair placed centrally on a plain, off-white background with a double-line rectangular border framing the composition. The chair features a green upholstered seat and backrest with dark outlining around its edges. The armrests are elaborately scrolled and outlined in dark brown or black, accented with gold or brass-colored decorative elements at the spiral ends and along the tops. The legs of the chair are also dark, with the front legs shaped to resemble animal legs and feet, which are highlighted with gold or brass tones to distinguish the sculpted detail. The word "BUSENBARK" is visible in small letters in the lower left corner of the page.
title: Armchair
